title: Senior AI Full-Stack Developer to Build Legal Document SaaS (Claude API, Fixed-Price)
description:
We are looking for an experienced full-stack AI developer or small senior team to build the first commercial version of Verdictum, a legal document analysis and drafting platform for Hungarian lawyers. We already have practical legal workflows, document templates, and access to lawyers who can test the product. We will provide domain expertise, anonymized sample documents, and feedback. Your role is to turn these workflows into a reliable, usable web application.

CORE WORKFLOW
Create a case → upload documents → extract and organize information → run guided AI analysis → generate a template-based draft → review and revise → export to Word.

INITIAL RELEASE REQUIREMENTS
• Secure user accounts and separate workspaces for law firms, with case-level access controls.
• PDF and DOCX upload, OCR for scanned documents, and preservation of document/page references.
• Claude API integration for structured, multi-step analysis and drafting.
• Answers and drafts linked to supporting source passages, with missing evidence and unsupported claims flagged for review.
• Configurable templates organized by case type, procedural stage, and drafting objective.
• Iterative drafting with user feedback, saved versions, and editable DOCX export.
• Basic administration, usage/cost monitoring, error handling, and reliable deployment.
• Hungarian-language interface and document processing.
We provide the Hungarian wording and legal validation. All generated legal work will remain subject to human review.

SCOPE AND DELIVERY
The first release will cover a limited, agreed set of legal workflows and templates. Before development, we will agree on the exact deliverables, document-volume limits, acceptance tests, and exclusions. Please identify what you can deliver within the budget and clearly state any proposed exclusions. Do not quote for a basic prototype if the working application described above would require a substantially larger follow-up budget. Target delivery: approximately 12 weeks from scope approval. Please propose a realistic schedule.

BUDGET AND PAYMENT
Indicative development budget: USD 10,000, fixed price for the agreed release. Payment will be tied to agreed deliverables and acceptance milestones. The initial technical validation and scope-definition milestone must be included in the total project price. Please disclose third-party services, licenses, hosting, AI API costs, and optional ongoing maintenance separately. Additional paid work requires prior written approval.

HANDOVER
• Source code committed to our repository throughout development.
• Deployment in accounts controlled by us.
• Documentation covering setup, architecture, prompts, workflows, and maintenance.
• Ownership of project-specific code and deliverables, with all third-party dependencies and license restrictions disclosed.
• An agreed post-delivery bug-fix period.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
You should have experience shipping complete AI web applications, including document ingestion, retrieval, source citations, background processing, and secure access controls. Using Claude Code or similar development tools is welcome, but you must personally take responsibility for architecture, testing, security, and maintainability. Python and React are preferred, but we are open to a well-supported alternative stack. Hungarian communication is a strong advantage; applicants who can work effectively with Hungarian documents and our domain team are also welcome.

PLEASE INCLUDE IN YOUR PROPOSAL
1. One or two relevant applications you have delivered, your exact role, and a demo or walkthrough where possible.
2. Your proposed architecture and approach to document references and citation verification.
3. Your fixed total price, milestone breakdown, timeline, and exclusions.
4. How you would handle large case files and prevent data from one client appearing in another client's results.
5. Estimated recurring costs and the usage assumptions behind them.
6. Your availability and who will personally perform the work.

Shortlisted candidates will receive a more detailed workflow brief and anonymized examples. Confidentiality is required before access to proprietary materials.
